title: Privacy Policy
subtitle: How we collect, use, and protect your personal data.

sections.heading: Data Controller
sections.body: Dra. Gabriella González Pane ("I", "my", "practice") is committed to protecting your personal data. This policy explains what data I collect, how I use it, and how I protect it, in compliance with Paraguay's Law No. 7.593/2025 on Personal Data Protection.

sections.heading: Personal data I collect
sections.body: I collect only the data necessary to provide dental care.
items: Dental health data (clinical history, X-rays, photographs)

sections.heading: Purpose of processing
items: Providing dental care and clinical follow-up
Communicating about appointments, treatments, and results

sections.heading: Legal basis
sections.body: Processing is based on: your explicit consent when booking a consultation; the execution of a dental services contract; and legal obligations applicable to professional dental practice.

sections.heading: Storage and security
sections.body: Your data is stored securely for the time necessary to fulfill legal and tax obligations (minimum 5 years from last visit, per Paraguayan health regulations). I implement technical and organizational measures to protect your data against unauthorized access.
